title: Rubix
tagline: Feeling bored at home? Rubix is your buddy. Play games, explore places and attend events with Rubix.
description:
Rubix is a city-based metaverse platform.

With rubix, a creator can host events or activities and distribute digital collectibles to participants.

When a player joins the platform, he or she is introduced to a bot buddy.
They continue to face challenges, complete missions, and explore the city.
how_its_made:
This project intends to use Covalent APIs to intearact with IPFS for data storage. Events hosted by creators appear on the map and stored on IPFS.
Digital goods (NFTs) are minted using POAP.

We are still in early stages of building the game, the integrations have not come through.
